sections.title: Contributors to population change in Eden
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component, %

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Eden, between 2025 and 2028:

  • More deaths than births meant that the population decreased by 2,724 people (−4.9%). In total, there were 3,890 births and 6,614 deaths in Eden between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in England) increased the population by 6,273 (11.3%). There were 27,757 people entering the area and 21,484 people leaving the area between 2025 and .
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) increased the population by 21 people (0.0%).as a result of 1,856 people entering the area and 1,835 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Eden's population of 331 (0.6%).as a result of 1,372 people entering the area and 1,041 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
